items.rationale: After 36 hours of Hannah silence post-Brendan's tracker, the Slack DM at 9 needs an email backup at 11 the same morning and a calendar hold for a 9 PM Thursday emergency review. Priya owns the calendar hold; Aisha owns the chase.

David sent a three-line nudge asking for the consolidation shape (not numbers) by Friday. He gets same-hour response on anything. A short framing paragraph is the right shape; the consolidation doc itself is still at "outline + half of section one."

David's three-sentence DM at 8:31 a.m. resolves the open question on whether to initiate a Vinod conversation—hold it, don't raise it. Aisha's v4 narrative (sent 6:52 a.m.) likely contains language suggesting a preliminary Vinod conversation; David's direction means that language needs revision before Friday's final read-ahead deadline (May 22, 5 p.m.). Between the first and second coffee, Aisha processes David's feedback and plans the Vinod-prelim language removal for Thursday or Friday revision.

Mrs. Reyes pushed the play start to 6:00 yesterday afternoon because the PIE board working session held the MUR; family calendar updated, refreshments setup at 6:00 now. Make sure Marcus saw the update.

Exploratory 30-min with Daniel Reyes (Anthropic, via Sasha) at 4pm — framed both sides as "let's just talk." Brendan signaled the David signoff is a hard-to-find slot through the 28th, so this stays as a conversation, not a step in a real loop.

Oura weekly summary — sleep average 5h 49m, four nights under 5h, readiness red. The pattern of exec-prep weeks. Form-email.
Cold recruiter email — Lattice external retained on "CPO, Lattice." Template, addressed Aisha by name. Ignored.
